description: Replaces the Day 0 mock login with Supabase Auth (email and password, sign-up disabled) for US-09 of PRD-LeaveTrack-v1.0; see ADR-LeaveTrack-E003. Identity is linked to public.users by lower(email). The mock login stays only as a labelled fallback behind ALLOW_MOCK_LOGIN. Deferred to HR user management: forced password change at first sign-in, emailed invites, HR creating users on screen.

summary: Supabase clients, env and session resolution
description: Add @supabase/ssr and @supabase/supabase-js (exact pins). Add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and ALLOW_MOCK_LOGIN to src/lib/env.ts and .env.example. getSession() reads the Supabase session and resolves the signed-in email to a public.users row with one SQL lookup on lower(email) (getDb(), once per request); the returned { role, user } shape is unchanged. The mock-role path only works when ALLOW_MOCK_LOGIN is true.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: a valid session for an email that has a users row returns that row's id, role and manager;AC2: a valid session for an email with no users row returns no session;AC3: with ALLOW_MOCK_LOGIN off the mock-role cookie yields no session;AC4: the lookup is lower-case insensitive and is made in SQL with the session email, never a client-sent id

description: src/proxy.ts validates the Supabase session and refreshes its cookies instead of trusting the role cookie. The mock-role cookie is honoured only when ALLOW_MOCK_LOGIN is true. /api/health stays public and /api/jobs/* stays behind the CRON_SECRET bearer check. Unauthenticated pages redirect to /login?next=...; unauthenticated /api/* returns the 401 envelope.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: a request without a valid session is redirected to /login (pages) or gets 401 (API);AC2: a request with a valid session reaches the page;AC3: the mock-role cookie is ignored when ALLOW_MOCK_LOGIN is off;AC4: /api/jobs/* is unaffected and still requires the cron bearer secret

summary: Login form and actions: email and password
description: Replace the mock login form with an email and password form that signs in through Supabase and redirects through safeNextPath(). The role-picker mock form remains, clearly labelled as a mock, only when ALLOW_MOCK_LOGIN is true. Sign out calls Supabase signOut and clears the cookies. Wrong credentials show one generic error; a valid account with no users row is signed out again with 'Your account is not set up. Ask HR.' Errors use role="alert" and every input has a label.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: a valid email and password signs the person in and lands on /dashboard as that person;AC2: a wrong password or unknown email shows one generic error and sets no session;AC3: a valid account with no users row shows the not-set-up message and sets no session;AC4: sign out ends the session and protected pages redirect to /login;AC5: the mock form is not rendered and its action refuses when ALLOW_MOCK_LOGIN is off

description: Replace the top header in src/components/ui/app-shell.tsx with the Figma left sidebar (frames 14:8878, 14:9401, 14:9931, 14:9946 in file GrKk5YyfJcDRdPBr7xXTF9) and a slim top bar. Nav items come from navItemsFor(role) and show only what the role may access (Employee 3, Manager 4, HR 5); the active item is highlighted; the sidebar collapses on desktop and becomes a drawer on mobile. The avatar in the top bar opens a menu with the signed-in email and Sign out. Supersedes the old header profile dropdown; removes the 1280px header wrap found on 2026-10-15. Replaces the top bar from commit 5afddfb on every signed-in page. Labels follow the Figma design.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: the sidebar shows only the nav items the signed-in role may access and highlights the current page;AC2: clicking the avatar shows the signed-in user's email and a Sign out action, keyboard-usable with aria-expanded, closed by Escape;AC3: the sidebar can be collapsed on desktop and opens as a drawer on mobile, with 44px targets;AC4: no header wrapping at 1280px and no horizontal overflow at 375px and 320px for employee, manager and HR;AC5: every page still calls requireSession() or requireRole() (the layout is not a security boundary)

summary: Script to create Supabase Auth users for the seeded emails
description: A local-only script that creates (or updates the password of) a Supabase Auth account for each email in supabase/seed.sql, with email confirmed and sign-up left disabled. The service-role key and the shared demo password come from the environment at run time; neither is committed, logged or used by the app or Vercel. Re-running is safe.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: running the script creates one Auth account per seeded email, each able to sign in;AC2: running it twice creates no duplicates and updates the password;AC3: the service-role key and password never appear in the repo, logs or app bundle

summary: CSP and security review for Supabase auth
description: Allow the Supabase project origin in the connect-src directive in next.config.ts with a comment explaining why (AGENTS.md). Confirm the session cookies are httpOnly, SameSite and Secure outside local development, that no token, cookie or request body is logged, and that no service-role key reaches the client.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: sign-in works under the production CSP with no console violations;AC2: session cookies are httpOnly and Secure on a non-development APP_ENV;AC3: grep and tests show no token or cookie value is logged and no service-role key is referenced in src

summary: Change-password page: voluntary, no forced change, no email
description: A signed-in page with a new password and a confirmation that calls Supabase's update-user call for the signed-in person. Voluntary: nothing forces a change at first sign-in, and nothing is emailed. First task to cut if time runs short; the demo accounts then keep the shared demo password.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: a signed-in user can set a new password and sign in with it afterwards;AC2: mismatched or too-short passwords are rejected with an inline error;AC3: the page requires a session and never shows or logs the password

description: Runbook plus verification. In the Supabase dashboard disable sign-ups and set the Site URL; add the Supabase URL and anon key to the Vercel project; run TASK-024; set ALLOW_MOCK_LOGIN deliberately for the demo. Click through the live URL as Elena, Marco, Hana and Leo. Most steps are the user's and no secret is pasted into chat.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: each seeded role signs in on the live URL and sees only their own data;AC2: Marco's queue never shows Leo's request when signed in as Marco;AC3: an email with no users row cannot get a session;AC4: the ALLOW_MOCK_LOGIN value on staging is recorded in the handoff
